name: Apply SSP projectors
summary: Applies precomputed signal-space projection (SSP) projectors (for example ECG or EOG) to continuous MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python and saves the cleaned raw FIF.
description: Adds the projectors from the projection file to the raw data with add_proj and applies them with apply_proj, saving raw.fif, and makes a joint plot of the projectors against an ECG-evoked response. Use it after an App that computes SSP projectors to remove the artefact components from the data.

inputs.description: Precomputed SSP projector file (.fif), for example from an ECG/EOG SSP App.

outputs.description: Joint plot (PNG) of the projectors and the ECG-evoked response.
Raw data (raw.fif) with the SSP projectors applied.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
